results.title: Urban Arrow launches its first longtail e-bike with impressive 100 Km range
results.description: Urban Arrow has launched its first longtail electric cargo bike, the Breeze, in North America. The e-bike features Bosch’s Cargo Line motor, 24-inch wheels, a Bosch Purion 200 display, and an 800h Bosch PowerPack battery. Plus, it’s available in green and black colorways.

results.title: New Chinese brand incoming
results.description: Another Chinese brand is coming to Australia, and it spells bad news for one local favourite.
